Theme 086 · Art movements & eras

Art Deco Marquee

A 1930s picture-palace premiere: sunbursts, stepped ziggurat frames, gold hairlines, chevrons and a marquee of bulbs, with Cassandre-style geometry holding the type. Acme's teal becomes lacquered night-green, amber plays the gold leaf and coral is kept for the one needle that swings too far.

COMPONENT KIT

  • Sunburst — alternating gold ray fans (7–14 % opacity) from a focal point
  • Stepped frame — ziggurat-cornered gold border, doubled with a hairline
  • Medallion — double-ringed circle holding a hero number or the mark
  • Floor-indicator dial — semicircular gauge with a teal safe zone and a coral needle
  • Stepped plaque — notched-corner button in gold or coral, tracked caps
  • Marquee bulbs — chasing lights around the CTA frame

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Sunburst bloom — rays scale 0→1 from the focal point, expo.out 0.75 s (1.5 beats), slow 2°/s rotation afterwards
  • Needle swing — rotation 0→−54° with elastic.out(1, .5) 0.9 s; the overshoot peak lands on the downbeat
  • Bulb chase — every third bulb dims, pattern shifts by one bulb per 16th note (0.125 s at 120 BPM)

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

Deco says occasion and craft — it makes a launch feel like a premiere and gives the anomaly a physical, analogue gauge that anyone can read. Risk: gold-on-dark can tip into casino or luxury-hotel kitsch; keep ornament to the frame and give data the centre.

Adapt to your product: Put your hero metric on the dial and your product's action on the plaque; the sunburst can radiate from your logo or from whatever your product produces. Works best for launches, anniversaries and premium tiers.

References: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Art_Deco — sunbursts, chevrons, stepped geometric forms · https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cassandre — Cassandre's Deco posters (Nord Express, Normandie) and the Peignot face
